decisions.reason: Underground dump trucks build directly on the firm's core underground drivetrain, safety and mining-customer knowledge, so it can interpret results and refine them, although dropping the sister loader line raises some doubt about the mining vehicle segment.
A construction site dumper reuses the firm's dumper and vehicle engineering know-how and serves its construction customers, letting it absorb feedback and improve the design at low added cost.
Inclined furniture lifts draw on the firm's established lifting expertise and certified quality and service processes, giving it the related knowledge to sustain and develop the line.
Inclined building material lifts are closely tied to both the firm's lifting know-how and its construction customer base, so the firm can readily assimilate market learnings.
The truck-mounted variant combines the firm's vehicle and lifting competences, so it fits its absorptive capacity, though it is a single niche model with somewhat higher risk.
